_comment: One switch, read by every generator and asserted by tools/verify_site.mjs.
noindex: true keeps the whole site out of the search index while the
relaunch is unfinished - subpages missing, the hero client-logo row not
cleared with the clients, the legal wording still English on a German-first
site. It is emitted as <meta name=robots> by every generator AND as an
X-Robots-Tag header in vercel.json, because a header also covers files no
Flipping it to false is the go-live gesture: set it here, set the header in
vercel.json to match, rebuild, and run node tools/verify_site.mjs - the gate
fails if the two disagree, which is the only reason this lives in a file
